% !tp-example Basic usage
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
\wcTpBox{
  Primary content group.

  \wcTpDivider{}
  Secondary content group.

}
\end{document}

% !tp-example Javascript API
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
\wcScript[type=module]|
import "/components/box/box.js";
import "/components/divider/divider.js";

const example = document.createDocumentFragment();

const element1 = document.createElement("tp-box");
element1.append(document.createTextNode("\n      "));

const element2 = document.createElement("p");
element2.append(document.createTextNode("Primary content group."));
element1.append(element2);
element1.append(document.createTextNode("\n      "));

const element3 = document.createElement("tp-divider");
element1.append(element3);
element1.append(document.createTextNode("\n      "));

const element4 = document.createElement("p");
element4.append(document.createTextNode("Secondary content group."));
element1.append(element4);
element1.append(document.createTextNode("\n    "));
example.append(element1);

document.body.append(example);
|
\end{document}

% !tp-example Custom style
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
\rawhtml|<style>
      .divider-custom-style tp-divider {
        --tp-divider-color: var(--tp-brand-fill-mid);
        --tp-divider-thickness: 4px;
        --tp-divider-margin-block: 0.75rem;
      }
    </style>|

\wcTpBox{
  \wcDiv[class=divider-custom-style]{
    Before the custom divider.

    \wcTpDivider{}
  }
  After the custom divider.

}
\end{document}

% !tp-example Dropdown menu
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
\wcTpDropdown[open]{
  \wcUl{
    \wcLi{Load}
    \wcTpDivider{}
    \wcLi{Save}
  }
}
\end{document}
